teams.title: Microsoft Teams
teams.description: Post task and status updates to your Teams channels
teams.name: Name
teams.webhookHelp: In Teams, open the channel menu (…) → Workflows → "Send webhook alerts to a channel", then paste the URL it gives you.
teams.secretNote: The webhook URL is stored encrypted and is not shown again after saving.
teams.ownerNote: The webhook runs as a Teams workflow owned by the person who created it. If that person leaves, it stops working, so add a co-owner in the Workflows app. Teams does not fully support posting to private channels yet.
